sentence: Part of the stories success is because of the friendship between the two main characters.
synonym: Some of the story's success comes from the friendship
synonymNote: 两者都表示故事成功的部分原因来自友谊，意思相同。

distractors.word: All of the story's success is due to the friendship
distractors.note: all表示全部，而非部分，意思不同。

distractors.word: The story fails because of the friendship
None of the story's success relates to the friendship
distractors.note: none表示完全无关，与原句意思相反。
